latent_processes: independent, unit stationary variance OU I and Matern32 S; same I and same S in both bands; S is added directly
fixed_kernel: Historical Starkey disk; BLR gamma k=2 onset=6 d, theta=7 d; U disk:BLR areas=9:1
metric: mean squared difference of binned log PSD means, standardized by fixed reference-model log PSD standard deviations; not chi-square likelihood
physical_selection: Deferred to user. No fast-driver or slow-dominance penalty; bounds and boundary proximity reported.
selection_rule: Independent joint max-band PSD discrepancy <= its simulated 95th percentile. Conditional compatibility screen, not a posterior or global post-selection p-value.
